```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(biomaRt)

covid_targets <- read_tsv("data/covid_19_targets.tsv")
hiv_targets <- read_tsv("data/hiv_targets.tsv")
hsv_targets <- read_tsv("data/hsv_targets.tsv")
```


```{r}
nodes <- read_delim(
  "data/new_taxdump/nodes.dmp",
  delim = "|",
  col_names = FALSE,
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  col_types = cols(.default = "c")
) %>%
  select(tax_id = X1, parent_tax_id = X2)

nodes <- nodes %>%
  mutate(
    tax_id = trimws(tax_id),
    parent_tax_id = trimws(parent_tax_id)
  )

root <- "3418604"

virus_taxids <- root
repeat {
  children <- nodes %>%
    filter(parent_tax_id %in% virus_taxids) %>%
    pull(tax_id)
  
  new_ids <- setdiff(children, virus_taxids)
  
  if (length(new_ids) == 0) break
  
  virus_taxids <- c(virus_taxids, new_ids)
}

virus_taxids <- sort(unique(virus_taxids))


length(virus_taxids)

corona_group <- virus_taxids
```

```{r}
start <- "2697049"

lineage <- start

repeat {
  parent <- nodes %>%
    filter(tax_id == lineage[length(lineage)]) %>%
    pull(parent_tax_id)

  if (length(parent) == 0) {
    stop("TaxID not found in nodes: ", start)
  }

  if (parent == lineage[length(lineage)]) break

  lineage <- c(lineage, parent)
}

```

```{r}
corona_proteins <- read_tsv("data/corona_proteins.tsv")
hhv_proteins <- read_tsv("data/hhv_proteins.tsv")

same_level_taxids <- function(taxid){
  parents <- nodes %>% filter(tax_id == taxid) %>% pull(parent_tax_id)
  parent <- parents[1]
  
  siblings <- nodes %>% filter(parent_tax_id == parent) %>% pull(tax_id)
  return(siblings)
}
```

```{r}
hhv_group <- same_level_taxids("10298")
corona_group <- same_level_taxids("2697049")
taxid <- "2697049"
ebola_group <- same_level_taxids("1570291")

hpv_group <- same_level_taxids("333761")
```

```{r}
filter_by_percentile <- function(df, score_col, percentile = 0.75) {
  threshold <- quantile(df[[score_col]], percentile, na.rm = TRUE)
  df %>% filter(.data[[score_col]] >= threshold)
}

```

```{r}
filter_data <- function(dataset){
  new_dataset <- dataset %>% 
    mutate(uniprot = ifelse(is.na(uniprotswissprot), uniprotsptrembl, uniprotswissprot))
  ids <- new_dataset %>% 
    distinct(uniprot) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(uniprot), uniprot != "") %>% 
    pull(uniprot) 
  return(ids)
}


join_filter <- function(dataset, original){
  new_dataset <- dataset %>%
    mutate(across(c(uniprotswissprot, uniprotsptrembl), ~ na_if(., ""))) %>%
    group_by(hgnc_symbol) %>%
    summarise(
      uniprot = coalesce(first(na.omit(uniprotswissprot)), first(na.omit(uniprotsptrembl))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    distinct(hgnc_symbol, uniprot)

  out <- inner_join(original, new_dataset, by = c("symbol" = "hgnc_symbol")) 
  out <- out %>% arrange(desc(globalScore)) %>% distinct(uniprot, .keep_all = TRUE)
  return(out)
}


hiv_new <- join_filter(hiv_targets_uniport, hiv_targets)
hsv_new <- join_filter(hsv_targets_uniprot, hsv_targets)
covid_new <- join_filter(covid_targets_uniprot, covid_targets)
```

```{r}
get_cdf_targets <- function(ot_df, disease_name = "a disease"){
  q_cutoffs <- tibble(
    pct = c(0.5, 0.75, 0.95),
    cutoff = quantile(ot_df$globalScore, pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    label = paste0(pct * 100, "th pct")) %>%
    arrange(cutoff) %>%
    mutate(y_pos = seq(0.75, 0.45, length.out = n()))  # spread labels vertically
  
  sorted_scores <- sort(ot_df$globalScore, decreasing = TRUE)
    top_n_cutoffs <- tibble(
      n = c(200, 150, 100, 50),
      cutoff = sorted_scores[c(200, 150, 100, 50)],
      label = paste0("top ", n)) %>%
    arrange(cutoff) %>%
    mutate(y_pos = seq(0.99, 0.8, length.out = n()))
  
  cdf_plot <- ot_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = globalScore)) + 
    stat_ecdf(aes(y = 1 - after_stat(y))) +
    geom_vline(data = q_cutoffs, aes(xintercept = cutoff), 
               linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    geom_text(data = q_cutoffs, 
              aes(x = cutoff, y = y_pos, label = label),
              angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, color = "red", size = 3) +
    geom_vline(data = top_n_cutoffs, aes(xintercept = cutoff), 
               linetype = "dotted", color = "blue") +
    geom_text(data = top_n_cutoffs, 
              aes(x = cutoff, y = y_pos, label = label),
              angle = 90, vjust = -0.5, color = "blue", size = 3) +
    labs(title = paste("Complementary cumulative distribution of global Score for", disease_name),
         y = "Fraction of interactions with global Score ≥ x") + 
    theme_bw()
  
  return(cdf_plot)
}

get_cdf_targets(covid_targets, "SARS-Cov-2")
ggsave("plots/cdf_ot_covid.jpeg", dpi=300)
get_cdf_targets(hsv_targets, "HSV-1")
ggsave("plots/cdf_ot_hsv.jpeg", dpi=300)
get_cdf_targets(hiv_targets, "HIV-1")
ggsave("plots/cdf_ot_hiv.jpeg", dpi=300)
```
